payload.text: I found 4 conditions related to brca1 [1][2][3][4].

BRCA1 is linked to four diseases: Familial cancer of breast [1], Familial breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility 1 [2], Pancreatic cancer susceptibility 4 [3], and Fanconi anemia complementation group S [4].
BRCA1 is a gene that acts as a tumor suppressor, helping keep genetic material stable inside cells [5].
Changes in this gene account for roughly 40% of inherited breast cancers and over 80% of inherited breast and ovarian cancers combined [5].

Research has explored how BRCA1 functions with other proteins in DNA protection [6], how nearby cells may encourage BRCA1-related breast tumors [7], how a tool called HRDetect can predict BRCA1 deficiency [8], and how blocking a process called ferroptosis protection can make BRCA1-deficient cancer cells more vulnerable to PARP inhibitor drugs [9].
BRCA1 has also been studied as a hormone and metabolism regulator [10].
